tier_meaning.UNRESOLVED_INTERNAL_ONLY: no data licence read from an authoritative source; internal research only; not cleared for redistribution or commercial use
tier_meaning.WRAPPER_LICENCE_UPSTREAM_CAVEAT: a licence on the aggregator's data repository was read, but upstream source terms were not separately granted; counted as NOT rights-cleared in the strict measure
tier_meaning.CLEARED_NONCOMMERCIAL_RESEARCH: the data author's licence was read verbatim and permits this research use (non-commercial, attribution, share-alike obligations apply)
tier_meaning.CLEARED_OPEN_LICENCE: open data licence (CC0) read verbatim from the data repository
tier_meaning.CLEARED_PROVIDER_TERMS_DIRECT_API: provider terms (owner-reported, text not agent-verified) permit research and commercial DERIVED outputs for data obtained through the provider's own authorised API under the owner's own subscription/key, within the shared quota; RAW data may not be redistributed. Applies only to data actually acquired that way
